description: Kenya - Flood extent for Kilifi, Garissa and Tana river is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Kenya Red Cross Society. This file contains flood hazard extent for Garissa, Kilifi and Tana River counties for the period 2018, 2019 and 2023. This data was obtained by merging flood extent from different sources among them UNOSAT. This data is in vector format. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Kenya Red Cross Society. Its tags are flooding, geodata, natural disasters. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
